headline: Responsibilities are what you owe—obligations to yourself, others, and the world you share
universal_truth: Rights and responsibilities are inseparable; claiming one requires honoring the other
fun_facts: Every right implies a corresponding responsibility—freedom of speech requires responsible speech
Responsibility comes from the Latin 'respondere'—to respond or answer
Mature societies balance individual rights with collective responsibilities
discussion_questions: What responsibilities do you take seriously?
How do you balance what you owe yourself versus others?
What happens when people claim rights without accepting responsibilities?

hook.script: Rights are what you're owed. Responsibilities are what you owe. Yesterday we explored rights; today we flip the coin. What do you owe others? What do you owe yourself? What do you owe the world you share?

cliff.script: It's tempting to focus on rights without responsibilities. But why are they inseparable?

options.text: Responsibilities complete the social contract—rights only work when others fulfill responsibilities; your right to safety requires others' responsibility not to harm; rights and duties are two sides of one coin
options.response: Yes. Rights exist in relationship. Your right implies someone's duty. Claiming rights while ignoring responsibilities is taking without giving—it collapses the system that makes rights possible.

options.text: Responsibilities are just obligations imposed on us
options.response: Some are imposed, but many are chosen—responsibilities to those we love, commitments we make...

fact1.title: To Self and Others
fact1.script: Responsibilities extend in all directions: to yourself (taking care of your wellbeing), to others (honoring commitments), to community (contributing to shared life). Each domain matters.

fact2.title: Chosen and Inherited
fact2.script: Some responsibilities are chosen—promises you make, roles you accept. Others are inherited—family, citizenship, humanity. Both are real. The key is conscious acceptance.

fact3.title: Reliability Matters
fact3.script: Responsibility is meaningless without follow-through. What you say you'll do, do. Reliability in responsibility builds trust. Broken promises erode social fabric.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Rights and responsibilities are inseparable. Claiming one requires honoring the other. Accept what you owe.

outro.script: That's Day 331. Tomorrow, we'll explore being part of a place—citizenship. Until then, consider what you owe and whether you're delivering.

growTrack.title: Responsibility Audit - What Do You Owe?
growTrack.activity: List your responsibilities—to yourself, to specific people, to your community. Which are you fulfilling well? Which are you neglecting? Choose one responsibility to strengthen this week.
